a.en: For coastal environments, hot-dip galvanized F1554 Grade 55 or 105 is the minimum specification. For severe marine exposure (within 500m of the ocean), specify 316 stainless steel anchors or duplex stainless anchors. All exposed portions (above concrete) must be protected, and stainless steel washers and nuts should be specified as well. When selecting, account for salt spray, wet-dry cycling, and chloride exposure, and have the engineer confirm the grade before it is written into drawings and inquiry. Do not upgrade only the bolt body to stainless while leaving nuts and washers in ordinary galvanized steel; the dissimilar pair will corrode at the joint. The order should record anchor diameter, grade, finish, and matching nut and washer material, and protect the protruding threads after concrete placement. Schedule periodic inspection of exposed anchor threads for red rust or section loss.
a.ja: 沿岸環境では、溶融亜鉛めっきを施した F1554 グレード55 または 105 のアンカーを最低仕様としてください。海から500m以内の厳しい海洋暴露では、316ステンレス鋼または二相ステンレス鋼のアンカーを指定します。コンクリートから出る露出部はすべて保護し、座金とナットもステンレス製でそろえます。選定にあたっては塩水噴霧、湿潤と乾燥の繰り返し、塩化物の暴露を考慮し、図面や引合いに書き込む前に設計者へ強度区分の確認を取ってください。ボルト本体だけステンレスへ格上げし、ナットや座金を普通の亜鉛めっき鋼のままにするのは避けてください。異種金属の組合せは接合部で腐食を進めます。注文書にはアンカーの径、強度区分、表面処理、組合せるナット・座金の材質を記録し、コンクリート打設後は突き出たねじ山を保護します。露出したアンカーのねじ山には赤錆や断面減少がないか、定期的な点検を計画してください。
a.fr: En milieu côtier, la spécification minimale exige des ancres F1554 Grade 55 ou 105 galvanisées à chaud. Pour une exposition marine sévère (à moins de 500 m de l'océan), spécifiez des ancres en inox 316 ou en acier inoxydable duplex. Toutes les parties exposées, au-dessus du béton, doivent être protégées, et les rondelles et écrous doivent également être en inox. Lors du choix, tenez compte du brouillard salin, des cycles humide-sec et de l'exposition aux chlorures, et faites confirmer la nuance par l'ingénieur avant de l'écrire sur les dessins et la demande d'offre. Ne faites pas passer uniquement le corps du boulon en inox en laissant écrous et rondelles en acier galvanisé ordinaire : le couple dissimilar corrodera au niveau du joint. La commande doit relever diamètre de l'ancre, nuance, finition et matériau assorti de l'écrou et de la rondelle, puis protéger les filets dépassant après le béton. Prévoyez une inspection périodique des filets exposés pour détecter la rouille rouge ou une perte de section.
a.pt: Em ambiente costeiro, a especificação mínima exige âncoras F1554 Grade 55 ou 105 galvanizadas a quente. Para exposição marinha severa (a menos de 500 m do oceano), especifique âncoras em inox 316 ou em aço inoxidável duplex. Todas as partes expostas acima do concreto devem ser protegidas, e as arruelas e porcas também devem ser de inox. Na seleção, leve em conta a névoa salina, os ciclos úmido-seco e a exposição aos cloretos, e peça ao engenheiro que confirme a qualidade antes de inscrevê-la nos desenhos e na consulta. Não eleve apenas o corpo do parafuso para inox deixando porcas e arruelas em aço galvanizado comum: o par dissimilar corroerá na junta. O pedido deve registrar diâmetro da âncora, qualidade, acabamento e material correspondente da porca e da arruela, e proteger as roscas salientes após o concreto. Programe inspeção periódica das roscas expostas quanto à ferrugem vermelha ou à perda de seção.
a.es: En entorno costero, la especificación mínima exige anclas F1554 Grade 55 o 105 galvanizadas en caliente. Para exposición marina severa (a menos de 500 m del océano), especifique anclas en inox 316 o en acero inoxidable dúplex. Todas las partes expuestas, por encima del hormigón, deben protegerse, y las arandelas y tuercas también deben ser inoxidables. Al elegir, tenga en cuenta la niebla salina, los ciclos húmedo-seco y la exposición a cloruros, y haga confirmar el grado por el ingeniero antes de escribirlo en planos y consulta. No mejore solo el cuerpo del perno a inox dejando tuercas y arandelas en acero galvanizado común: la pareja disimilar corroerá en la unión. El pedido debe registrar diámetro del ancla, grado, acabado y material correspondiente de tuerca y arandela, y proteger las roscas salientes tras el hormigón. Programe una inspección periódica de las roscas expuestas por óxido rojo o pérdida de sección.
a.ar: في البيئة الساحلية، تشترط المواصفة الدنيا مراسي F1554 Grade 55 أو 105 مجلفنة بالغمس الساخن. أما التعرض البحري الشديد (على بعد أقل من 500 m من المحيط) فيتطلب مراسي من الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ 316 أو من الفولاذ الثنائي. يجب حماية جميع الأجزاء المكشوفة فوق الخرسانة، ويجب أن تكون الحلقات والصواميل من الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ أيضًا. عند الاختيار، خذ في الحسبان رذاذ الملح ودورات الرطوبة والجفاف والتعرض للكلوريدات، واطلب من المهندس تأكيد الدرجة قبل كتابتها في الرسومات والاستعلام. لا ترفع درجة جسم البرغي وحده إلى الفولاذ المقاوم للصدأ مع ترك الصواميل والحلقات من الفولاذ المجلفن العادي؛ فالزوج غير المتجانس يتآكل عند الوصلة. يجب أن يسجل الطلب قطر المرساة والدرجة والتشطيب ومادة الجوز والحلقة المتطابقة، وحماية الخيوط البارزة بعد صب الخرسانة. نظم فحصًا دوريًا للخيوط المكشوفة بحثًا عن الصدأ الأحمر أو نقص المقطع.
a.zh: 沿海环境最低采用热浸镀锌的 F1554 Grade 55 或 105 锚栓。严重海洋暴露区域（距海 500 m 以内），应规定 316 不锈钢锚栓或双相不锈钢锚栓。混凝土以上外露的所有部分都必须得到保护，配套的垫圈和螺母同样要选用不锈钢件，不能只把螺栓本体升级为不锈钢而连接件仍用普通镀锌钢。选型时还要核对盐雾环境、干湿交替与氯化物影响，必要时由结构或材料工程师确认等级，再写入采购图纸与询价单。

q.en: What are the different types of anchor bolts for concrete?

a.en: Main anchor bolt types: J-bolts (L-shaped, for equipment mounting); L-bolts (straight with bent end); Plate anchors (welded base plate, for structural columns); Wedge anchors (expansion type, for cracked/uncracked concrete); Epoxy anchors (adhesive-bonded, for high loads). Each type suits different load requirements and concrete conditions.

q.en: How do I determine the correct anchor bolt size for my project?

a.en: Determine anchor bolt size by: 1) Calculate design load (tension and shear); 2) Check concrete strength (typically 20-30 MPa for African construction); 3) Use manufacturer load tables for specific bolt size and embedment depth; 4) Apply appropriate safety factor (typically 4:1 for static loads); 5) Consider edge distance and spacing requirements.

q.en: What is the difference between wedge anchors and J-bolts?

a.en: Wedge anchors are expansion anchors that grip the concrete when tightened - one-piece design, for permanent installations in solid concrete. J-bolts are cast-in-place or inserted into wet concrete - repositionable before concrete sets, better for structural connections where alignment is critical.

q.en: How deep should anchor bolts be embedded in concrete?

a.en: Embedment depth depends on bolt diameter and load: General rule is 4-6 bolt diameters for medium loads. For structural applications, follow local codes: South Africa uses SABS 10400; minimum typically 8 inches (200mm) for M16 and larger bolts. Insufficient embedment causes pull-out failure - always verify with load calculations.

q.en: When should epoxy anchor bolts be used?

a.en: Use epoxy anchors when: 1) High tensile load requirements exceed expansion anchor capacity; 2) Close to concrete edge where expansion anchors would crack concrete; 3) Retrofitting existing concrete structures; 4) Anchoring near vibrating equipment. Epoxy provides chemical bonding and works in both cracked and uncracked concrete when properly installed.

faqItems.question: What are the different types of anchor bolts for concrete?
faqItems.answer: Main anchor bolt types: J-bolts (L-shaped, for equipment mounting); L-bolts (straight with bent end); Plate anchors (welded base plate, for structural columns); Wedge anchors (expansion type, for cracked/uncracked concrete); Epoxy anchors (adhesive-bonded, for high loads). Each type suits different load requirements and concrete conditions.

faqItems.question: How do I determine the correct anchor bolt size for my project?
faqItems.answer: Determine anchor bolt size by: 1) Calculate design load (tension and shear); 2) Check concrete strength (typically 20-30 MPa for African construction); 3) Use manufacturer load tables for specific bolt size and embedment depth; 4) Apply appropriate safety factor (typically 4:1 for static loads); 5) Consider edge distance and spacing requirements.

faqItems.question: What is the difference between wedge anchors and J-bolts?
faqItems.answer: Wedge anchors are expansion anchors that grip the concrete when tightened - one-piece design, for permanent installations in solid concrete. J-bolts are cast-in-place or inserted into wet concrete - repositionable before concrete sets, better for structural connections where alignment is critical.

faqItems.question: How deep should anchor bolts be embedded in concrete?
faqItems.answer: Embedment depth depends on bolt diameter and load: General rule is 4-6 bolt diameters for medium loads. For structural applications, follow local codes: South Africa uses SABS 10400; minimum typically 8 inches (200mm) for M16 and larger bolts. Insufficient embedment causes pull-out failure - always verify with load calculations.

faqItems.question: When should epoxy anchor bolts be used?
faqItems.answer: Use epoxy anchors when: 1) High tensile load requirements exceed expansion anchor capacity; 2) Close to concrete edge where expansion anchors would crack concrete; 3) Retrofitting existing concrete structures; 4) Anchoring near vibrating equipment. Epoxy provides chemical bonding and works in both cracked and uncracked concrete when properly installed.
